blog.intro:
Mili Talks is a blog where we share our vintage know-how, hands-on experience, and the real perspective we have built through years in the field.

We explore the background, details, and stories behind vintage pieces — especially military and denim — to make the world of vintage approachable for newcomers too.

We also hope to grow a community where collectors and people who share the same values can connect.

references.intro:
Much of the information presented here is based on various documents, references, and knowledge shared by the websites, dealers, brands, shops, and collectors listed below.

Amb:STORAGE conducts its own research and verification, then selects, supplements, and edits those materials into each piece of content.

Because vintage is a culture with many interpretations, the same subject may have different theories. We hope these articles become a starting point for discovering vintage from a deeper perspective.
